free_tier.stated: Rent on-demand GPU workers by the hour, pay as you go

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: an OpenAI-compatible key plus the vendor's own clients
chaining: The free tier serves inference only from a worker the user installs on their own GPU; Pendra hosts no free inference allocation. The models.dev free-model list reflects that per-account worker catalogue.

limits.value: Free plan includes 1 self-hosted worker; on-demand GPUs bill hourly; Pro is GBP 99 a month

identity_cost.detail: free account at console.pendra.ai; the free tier needs the user's own GPU hardware for a worker

reliability_note: requests to a model not installed on any worker return an error

evidence.proved: Pendra's free plan provides one self-hosted worker and hourly on-demand GPU rental, with no hosted free inference
evidence.quote: Rent on-demand GPU workers by the hour, pay as you go
